summary: Rabbi Besser discusses the spiritual significance of the creation of man in Beresheet, focusing on the concept of Emet and the importance of speech. He further explores the role of women in the Torah, explaining the meaning of the blessing She'asani Kirtzono and the concept of Binah.
questions: Why does Hashem's signature, Emet, appear at the end of the first words of the Torah?
Is lying considered a serious prohibition in the Torah?
Why is man called Adam if his most important part is the Neshama?
What is the meaning behind the blessing She'asani Kirtzono?
How should we understand the role of a wife as Ezer Kinegdo?
